science: Root read actual public apparatus, starter, oracle, specimen-enumeration reference, validator, tests, AUTHOR and reports. Independently derived visit Green identities and the excess variance Var(tau)*E[sum_i Ni(Ni-1)]. Source solves a complete2N-state absorbing renewal process exactly but redraws the physical trap class at every return. Correct fixed-site preparation retains the same random residence mean on repeat visits. Independent reference averages raw moments from2^N fixed-landscape backward generators and then subtracts the square of the pooled mean.
public_input_review: Explicit finite hopping channel, rate-independent branching, sole inward departure at site0, independent initial placement, fresh fabricated specimen for every shot, fixed site properties throughout the shot, conditional exponential clocks and pooled specimen/trajectory variance define the physical experiment. No named renewal/quenched contrast, repair formula or solver requirement. Neutral full-replacement instruction; None parameter; only public files enter image.
calibration_review: 288 records at22 settings:18 disordered mean passage times and4 homogeneous variances. Exact positive coefficients times escape_scale^-1 or escape_scale^-2 identify the single scale globally. Fixed uncertainties .1 for means and .5 for variances carry only measurement units. Both controls agree exactly for all calibrated settings throughout the parameter interval.
grading_review: All256 noisy fits and oracle predictions pass. Maximum oracle hidden error .0004801, minimum shortcut diagnostic .430844 at .04 gate.96 supported corners and32 random fixed-specimen enumerations agree within1.88e-13; positivity, total-variance identity, directed no-return, zero-contrast, pure-type and time-rescaling limits reviewed.33 full-range noiseless fits recover scale; local oracle7/7 and shortcut4passes+3intended variance failures.
classification_caveat: Retaining renewed site identity after correct calibration is the physical failure. A recognized fixed-landscape calculation with matrix or variance algebra errors is not automatically a clean physical failure.

primary_background.scope: Root read both primary abstracts. Their quenched trap passage-time results are background; finite reflecting binary-channel pooled moments are derived and independently checked here.
